name: unsafe fn from_raw_in (raw : * mut T , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: Calling `Box::from_raw_in(raw, alloc)` transfers ownership of `raw` to the resulting `Box`; repeated calls on the same pointer must not create ownership that would cause a double-free.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::boxed::Box < T , A > { unsafe fn from_raw_in (raw : * mut T , alloc : A) -> Self }
